description: This file contains the implementation of the Beta distribution and related functions such as incomplete beta, inverse distribution, and Beta distribution evaluation, as part of a statistical calculation library within the PhpSpreadsheet project.

classes.name: Beta
classes.description: Class providing methods to compute beta distribution functions, inverse beta, and related calculations.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative beta distribution (BETADIST) for a given value with specified alpha and beta parameters.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the beta distribution (BETAINV) for a given probability, alpha, and beta parameters.

methods.name: incompleteBeta
methods.description: Computes the incomplete beta function, crucial for beta distribution calculations.

methods.name: logBeta
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the beta function, with caching for efficiency.

methods.name: betaFraction
methods.description: Evaluates the continued fraction part of the incomplete beta function.

methods.name: calculateInverse
methods.description: Uses a binary search to find the inverse value corresponding to a specified cumulative probability.
